summary: P3 (probe): on a canon.yaml with no `routing:` section, `canon change defer` is CONFIG_INVALID TIERS with the hint 'run `canon migrate` to preview the line it adds', but migrate skips such a file by design (F9) and adds nothing, so the hint loops. Brief F9 asks this case's hint to say to add the line. Fix: in tiers_refusal, when canon.yaml has no routing section, say to add `routing:` with `change_state: local` by hand.
